date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: R6-SC-005-D1: Contemporary TNN, The News and Pajhwok report 21 September as the closure date. This is preferred to APP’s internally inconsistent 9 September date alongside its nine-day duration. The News and Geo share a reporter; overlapping accounts are not counted as wholly independent. Reported nine-day wording is approximate and not a measured elapsed duration. The 1 October vehicle reopening is supported. Scope is Kharlachi, not the whole Pakistan–Afghanistan frontier; regional shortages are not attributed solely to this post.
